title: Scorecard
description: How well aidev-po is doing for one products repo (one client or team), stored at <products repo>/.po/scorecard.json. Two parts. skills: ai-sdlc-loop's per-skill scorecard, unchanged in meaning: po adds a run entry per skill after each run, each criterion scored 0 to 2, verdict set after the user's review (keep at 70% or more of the maximum in at least two runs with no harm flag; drop if never triggered or 40% or less in every run where it applied; merge if its effect cannot be told apart from another skill's; the user's note overrides any score). measures, stages, causes and summary: written by scripts/scorecard.py update from the product folders' trace, feedback, attribution and register files and the ledger; never edited by hand.

generated.description: When scripts/scorecard.py last wrote the computed parts.

followed.description: The producer did what the dos and don'ts say.

reviewer_caught.description: The reviewer used its checks and found or confirmed something real.

outcome.description: A defect was prevented or caught, fewer loops, or a better artefact.

cost.description: The tokens and time were worth it.

total.description: The sum of the scores; scripts/scorecard.py check checks it.

harm_flag.description: It caused wrong work, a loop or bloat.

measures.description: One entry per product run, in time order.

items_written.description: Distinct items with a write line in this run.

trace_complete_pct.description: Share of those items whose trace passes scripts/traces.py check, as a percentage. Target 100.

feedback.description: Feedback on items as written in this run (by the rev the feedback names), plus run-level feedback that names this run.

feedback_per_100_items.description: feedback / items_written * 100, rounded to one decimal; null when no items were written.

reviewer_findings.description: Findings naming items of this run in review lines of the trace.

reviewer_catch_share.description: reviewer_findings / (reviewer_findings + feedback total) as a percentage: how much was caught before the user saw it. null when both are zero.

attributions.description: Current attributions for this run's feedback.

origins_in_run.description: Attributions, for any feedback, whose origin step is in this run: where errors began rather than where they were noticed.

confirmed.description: Of this run's attributions, how many the user confirmed.

repeat_causes.description: Attributions with origin in this run whose cause key (cause and origin agent) was already seen in an earlier run in this products repo.

recurrence_after_edit.description: Attributions with origin in this run whose cause key matches an accepted ledger edit applied before the run. Target 0.

stages.description: Questions per gate, per product and stage. Each run of a stage ends at a gate.

questions.description: Register declare lines of type question for the stage.

causes.description: How often the same cause comes back. One entry per cause key: the cause and the origin agent.

after_edit.description: Times it came back after an accepted, applied ledger edit for the same cause key.

held_out_regressions.description: Accepted ledger edits that had any held-out regression. Target 0.
